docs.title: Settings
docs.text: The Fleet & Road Realism settings are in the game under Options, in the mod's own tile. All changes take effect immediately.

docs.title: Registration, insurance and vehicle tax
docs.text:
Standard: random plates, no insurance or tax

Registration system: choose plates, insurance, tax

You can switch at any time and the change applies immediately. While switched off, insurance and vehicle tax are paused; nothing is charged for the pause when you switch back on.

docs.title: Licence plate row in the HUD
docs.text: Shows a row about the licence plates of truck and trailer above the finances in the HUD: temporary and transfer plates with the remaining days and the expiry date, deregistered vehicles in red.

docs.title: Documents – display
docs.text:
Where the vehicle papers in the cab can be seen. Interior view only: hidden in the exterior view. Interior and exterior view: also visible from outside through the windows.

Off · Interior view only · Interior and exterior view

docs.title: Documents – detail
docs.text:
Sharpness of the vehicle papers in the cab (e.g. transfer documents). Independent of the licence plate detail: higher levels use more places in the licence plate atlas, but no additional video memory.

Normal · High · Ultra

docs.title: Place for registration documents
docs.text:
Where the vehicle papers lie in the cab. If the chosen place does not exist in the vehicle (e.g. no bed in a short cab), they lie on the engine tunnel.

Engine tunnel · Passenger seat · Bed · Dashboard

docs.title: Foreign license plates in AI traffic
Share of foreign vehicles
docs.text: 0 % = none, 100 % = all cars, trucks and buses are foreign. Police, taxis etc. always stay local.

docs.title: Share in cities
docs.text: Share of the value above that applies in cities. 100 % = same as outside, 50 % = half as many.

docs.title: Trailers from another country
docs.text: How many trailers carry a different country than their truck.

docs.title: Advanced: set share per vehicle type (Trucks, Buses, Cars)
docs.text: Sets the foreign share for trucks, buses and cars individually. The first slider then has no effect.

docs.title: Fleet management
docs.text: Fixed combinations: in the truck manager each truck gets a fixed trailer via the trailer field. It moves to the truck’s garage and is coupled when you get in. Getting in offers matching buttons. Off: everything as in the game.

docs.title: Park trailer when unhitching
docs.text:
If you unhitch your own trailer with the uncouple key while you have no job, it is parked there – only outside company premises. It stays at that spot, is shown with its own icon on the world map and in the navigation, and does not go back to its garage. You then take freight jobs solo; if your trailer is still hitched, you must first park it outside the company premises.

Off: game behaviour – the trailer goes to its garage when you accept a job.

docs.title: Show coupling aid on trailers
docs.text: Shows the white frame and the rotating cone on unhitched trailers. When off, both are hidden on all trailers; coupling still works as usual.

docs.title: Show coupling aid on parked trailer
docs.text: Shows the white frame and the rotating cone on your parked trailer. When off, they are hidden only there. Only available when the coupling aid on trailers is switched on.

docs.title: Split own doubles when loading
docs.text: When loading, your own double is spread over several loading lanes: put each part on its lane and detach it, load the front part and then couple everything back together. Only for trailers with the loading entry in the chassis v3def. Sets g_simple_parking_doubles to 0.

docs.title: Show coupling aid on split doubles
docs.text: Shows the frame and cone of the coupling aid on the trailers parked while loading or unloading a split double. Independent of the other two coupling aid settings.

docs.title: Load-sensing brake (ALB)
docs.text: Adjusts the brake pressure per axle to the load like a real load-sensing valve: less braking force when empty so the wheels do not lock, full braking force when fully loaded. Applies to semi-trailers, trailers and your own truck.

docs.title: Automatic height adjustment when coupling
docs.text: Adjusts the height automatically while approaching: the lorry's rear to the trailer, and for doubles trailer 1 to part 2. Off: set the height yourself with the suspension. Automatic lowering when the landing gear does not reach the ground always stays active.

docs.title: Main mirror left, Wide-angle mirror left, Main mirror right, Wide-angle mirror right
docs.text: Switches this mirror between its normal and manoeuvring position while driving. Set both positions in the mirror menu (Tab switches the mode). Click the field, then press a key or button – keyboard, controller, wheel or button box. Esc cancels, Del clears the binding. If the key is already used in the game, it is removed there – just like in the game's key options.

docs.title: Raindrops on mirrors
docs.text: When it rains, drops form on the mirror glass just like on the windows. Works with mirrors whose mod supports it.

docs.title: Screenwash and windscreen dirt
docs.text: Jet, water, run-off and dirt (dust, insects, mud) on the windscreen. Turning it off saves performance.

docs.title: Rain inside the cab
docs.text: With a side window open, rain comes in: flying drops and wet surfaces in the cab. Turning it off saves performance.

docs.title: Screenwash colour
docs.text:
Colour of the screenwash in the jet and on the windscreen.

Blue · Green · Yellow · Red/pink · Violet

docs.title: Radius for partial loads
docs.text: Further partial loads of a trip only from senders and to receivers within this radius (road km) around the parts already planned. Applies to normal trailers.

docs.title: Radius for partial loads (doubles, HCT, 2x20)
docs.text: As above, for doubles, HCT and container chassis with 2x20.

docs.title: Secure cargo yourself
docs.text: The cargo must be secured by yourself before departure. Without the tick the game takes care of it as before.

docs.title: Size of symbols in the world
docs.text: Size of the clickable symbols on vehicle and cargo (twistlocks, hooks, arrows, levers, edge protectors). HUD, legend and hints stay unchanged.

docs.title: Opacity of symbols in the world
docs.text: Opacity of the clickable symbols on vehicle and cargo. 100 % = fully visible.

docs.title: Show cargo securing legend
docs.text: Shows the legend with the symbols while securing and unsecuring the cargo – independent of the HUD.

docs.title: Notifications
docs.text:
Turns e-mails and HUD messages of this kind on or off. Charges and payments are still applied without a notification.

E-mail HUD Taxes & charges ✓ ✓ Vehicle tax with tax notices and refunds, and distance-based charges such as heavy vehicle charges. Payments are still made without a notification. Insurance ✓ ✓ Insurance certificate and contract changes, premium debits, claims, downgrades and comprehensive or cargo damage. Payments are still made without a notification. Clients ✓ ✓ Damage invoices from clients for damaged cargo or a damaged job trailer. Payments are still made without a notification. Registration ✓ ✓ Expiry of temporary plates, delivery of newly bought vehicles and a warning when such a plate is not valid abroad. Night speed limits – ✓ Notice when night speed limits for lorries begin and end and when entering a country where they currently apply. HUD message only. Vehicle transport ✓ ✓ Invoice for vehicle transport when a vehicle may not drive itself while being moved to another garage (deregistered, temporary plate expired or not valid there). Charged even without notification. Parking trailers – ✓ Messages when parking your own trailers: parked, or why not (company yard, active job, split combination). Instructions on what to do are always shown. Waiting times – ✓ Waiting time messages at companies: check-in with waiting time, remaining time and release. Instructions on what to do are always shown. Sign on permanently – ✓ Messages for “Sign on permanently”: tour booked, booking cancelled, tour start. Instructions on what to do are always shown.

docs.title: Licence plate detail
docs.text:
Choose the detail level of license plates. Higher levels are sharper but use more video memory.

Normal – game's standard resolution (approx. 11 MB)

High – double resolution (approx. 43 MB, recommended)

Ultra – quadruple resolution (approx. 171 MB)

docs.title: Multicore
docs.text: The mod writes its log file on a second CPU core. The game does not have to wait for it, so short stutters while writing are avoided. Useful for processors with several cores.

docs.title: Confirm SDK notice automatically
docs.text: At start-up ETS2 shows a notice from SCS about plugins: no warranty of functionality or performance; the game is not licensed for professional driving simulators, driver training or internet cafés. Ticking this box confirms the notice permanently – it is closed automatically with OK at start-up.

docs.title: Features
docs.text: An overview of everything Fleet & Road Realism does in the game. What can be switched on and off is listed under Settings.

docs.title: Number plates
docs.text:
• Real number plates for every country in the game, in high resolution (detail level Normal, High or Ultra).
  • Foreign plates in AI traffic: overall share, share in cities, trailers and, if you like, separately for trucks, buses and cars. Police, taxis etc. always stay local.

docs.title: Registration, insurance and vehicle tax
docs.text:
Optional (setting Registration, insurance and vehicle tax). When off, you get random plates without insurance or tax, as in the game.

  • Purchase: The dealer fits every newly bought vehicle with a temporary plate of the country where you buy it – included in the price. Expiry and validity abroad are announced; the HUD line shows the remaining days. The papers lie in the cab.
  • Registration: In the service shop (registration office → Re-register) you register or re-register the vehicle permanently: country, state or registration district and plate – as a random suggestion or with your own letters and digits following the real rules of the country. The country is preselected to the one you are in.
  • Deregistration: A deregistered vehicle gets a blank plate; tax and insurance end. Driving deregistered or without liability insurance risks the fines of the country.
  • Insurance: Liability and comprehensive cover with no-claims classes, premium payments, downgrading after damage; cargo and job-trailer damage. On the road you manage it in the Personal settings window.
  • Vehicle tax and charges following the rules of the country of registration, with tax notice and refund; plus distance-based charges such as the Swiss LSVA. Tax keeps running while the vehicle stands in the garage.

docs.title: Fleet
docs.text:
• Garage relocation: If a vehicle may not drive itself (deregistered, temporary plate expired or not valid there), it is brought by a vehicle transport – with an invoice.
  • Fleet management: Fixed truck and trailer combinations.
  • Parking trailers: Unhitch your own trailers without a job outside company premises and leave them there; they are shown on the map.
  • Doubles and HCT: Split your own doubles over several loading bays; animated rear bumper; automatic height matching when coupling.
  • ALB: Load-sensing brakes for semi-trailers, trailers and your own truck – empty vehicles no longer lock up.

docs.title: Jobs and cargo market
docs.text:
• Opening hours of companies: closed companies offer nothing.
  • Waiting times at companies with check-in and release.
  • Partial loads, mixed loads and tour planning in the cargo market with your own trailer; every cargo must fit by weight, volume and dimensions.
  • Pay for freight jobs like real haulage; surcharges per cargo.
  • Container traffic with reach stacker terminals and container chassis with up to 16 slots.

docs.title: Driver mode
docs.text:
The game's quick jobs have been rebuilt into a proper driver mode: you drive as an employed driver with the employer's truck and trailer.

  • Tour instead of single job: You choose the period you want. Cargo and destination show the first stop, the rest follows on the way – taking over cargo at a provided trailer, loading at the bay, return loads, empty runs.
  • Working time: Driver jobs are only available from Sunday 22:00 to Friday 18:00.
  • Pay: Wage and expenses, night bonus, ADR allowance. Deductions are paid by the employer.
  • Quitting: immediately (next parking area, engine off) or after the current job. No penalty, wage and expenses until the end.
  • Sign on permanently: At the end of a tour the employer asks whether you want to carry on. After a short tour the next one starts after 11 h rest, after a full week after 45 h weekly rest. The booked tour is shown in the box at the top left, where it can be cancelled. While a tour is booked, freight jobs, cargo market and subcontracting are locked.
  • Waiting times at companies can be bridged with a rest.

docs.title: Securing cargo
docs.text: Optional (Secure cargo yourself): twistlocks on containers, straps and chains – hook on, throw over, tension the ratchet –, edge guards, anti-slip mats. Unsecured or badly secured cargo can slide and tip. Click icons: red = still to do, orange/yellow = mouse over, green = done.

docs.title: Traffic rules
docs.text:
• Truck driving bans per country and city by weekday, time and weight, with exemptions for certain cargo and fines. A HUD notice appears while a ban applies.
  • Night speed limits for trucks with a notice at start, end and when entering a country.

docs.title: Vehicle and interior
docs.text:
• Mirrors: Switch each outside mirror between normal and manoeuvring position with a key; rain drops on the mirror glass.
  • Windscreen washer with jet, water and run-off; windscreen dirt (dust, insects, mud); washer fluid colour selectable.
  • Rain in the cab with the side window open.
  • Vehicle papers in the cab, place selectable.
